messages:
ria (cs): Quick capture — just off a 30m onboarding with ClearCo (PM: Priya). Key asks: (1) per-route billing toggle in the Console so they can disable embedding routes for certain teams; (2) embeddings stability — they saw intermittent failures/timeouts during bulk ingest; (3) SLA/usage export for renewals. They're mid-trial; renewal looks contingent on cost visibility. TL;DR: high priority.

noah (product): Thanks — can you paste a direct quote or repro steps for the embedding failures? Filing as potential P1 for trial health.

ria (cs): Quote from Priya: "We see spikes where half our batches fail with 504s, and it's blocking our data uploads." Repro summary: bulk ingest via /v1/embeddings with ~50k vectors split across 3 jobs; failures at ~10–15% after warmup. I'll DM detailed logs and trace ids. Also requested a UI toggle for route-level disable.

sam (cs): Adding that they want cost-per-route per-day in CSV export for finance reporting.

owen (eng): 504s could be batching timeout or model fallback. @noah can you point me to the runbook? I'll start looking at runtime logs for that tenant.

noah (product): Can you create a GH issue or Jira for traceability? If runtime, we'll need trace ids and sample requests. Quick poll: +1 to add to backlog as "visibility" (low effort Q2); +2 to prioritize for trial retention (ship fast). Vote with reactions.

ria (cs): Sending logs to #eng-runtime and raising a ticket. For prioritization I'd mark as "should fix before EOW" if failures are reproducible — this is a renewal risk.

feedback-bot: Created ticket RF-4123: clearco-embeddings-failures. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RF-4123 :white_check_mark: 

noah (product): If we can't guarantee a fast fix, propose a temporary workaround: recommend they segment uploads + exponential backoff. Sam — can you draft a short enablement note for CSMs to send to trial accounts?

sam (cs): On it. Draft going to #cs-templates in a few mins. Will include CSV export steps and a "limit concurrency" snippet: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"batch_size":500, "concurrency":2}'```

ria (cs): Thanks. Tagging renewal note: account at-risk if per-route cost not visible by renewal touch in ~3 weeks. I'll follow up with Priya about acceptable workaround and record in account health doc.

owen (eng): Starting investigation now, will post traces and preliminary findings in this thread.

noah (product): Decision for now: product will triage RF-4123; aim to ship a UI toggle as a low-risk Q2 patch if feasible. If not, produce enablement + export docs as the mitigation. @ria please update the account health sheet with this action + ETA.
